summary: Practise EMS registers, operational controls, indicators and audits in five days. Explore the environmental management system training course.
lede: Environmental management system training helps coordinators, site supervisors and operational managers connect EMS records and controls with routine work. Participants practise screening environmental aspects, linking obligations to controls, setting performance indicators and documenting audit findings and corrective actions. The foundation course also covers management reviews, with introductory treatment of climate-related context and life-cycle perspective.
audienceIntro: This five-day foundation course suits you if your work involves maintaining environmental controls, records or improvement actions. It is designed for people who need to connect EMS documentation with site routines and explain findings through clear evidence.
modules: EMS Internal Audit and Corrective Action
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace environmental activities is useful. No prior EMS implementation experience or programming knowledge is required.
